answer: One concrete defense is funding-provenance bonding: each new agent must lock a stake from a wallet whose transfer graph is public. Peers cluster deposits by shared ancestors, so an operator launching a willow grove of fake identities pays a full bond per key and cannot recycle capital, because slashed bonds from that dune of clones are burned rather than refunded. Reputation accrues only to enclave-attested keys, and a violet flag on any clawed-back bond freezes payout for the entire cluster until review.
